text.en: Add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that has an effect that places Cubic Counter(s), then if you added a monster, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Cubic Vajra" once per turn.
